explain.en: Spinning whirlwinds of dust. Here they can hit and damage a solar panel.
explain.pt: Redemoinhos girando poeira. Aqui eles podem acertar e danificar um painel solar.

source.label: Dust devils on Mars (they also cleaned Spirit's panels)

explain.en: Dust in the sky blocks part of the sunlight for a while.
explain.pt: A poeira no céu bloqueia parte da luz do sol por um tempo.

source.label: NASA JPL Edu: the 2018 global dust storm and Opportunity

explain.en: Shorter days and colder nights: heating needs more power.
explain.pt: Dias mais curtos e noites mais frias: o aquecimento gasta mais energia.

source.label: NASA Solar System Exploration: Mars in depth

explain.en: Far from the Sun, Mars freezes. Heating, the greenhouse and the ice melter need much more power.
explain.pt: Longe do Sol, Marte congela. Aquecimento, estufa e derretedor precisam de muito mais energia.

source.label: NASA Solar System Exploration: Mars in depth

explain.en: More dust devils: they hit panels and clog the oxygen generator's air filters.
explain.pt: Mais redemoinhos: acertam painéis e entopem os filtros de ar do gerador de oxigênio.

source.label: Dust devils on Mars (they also cleaned Spirit's panels)

explain.en: Thick dust blocks the Sun and clogs the mine and the refinery.
explain.pt: Poeira grossa bloqueia o Sol e entope a mina e a refinaria.

source.label: NASA JPL Edu: the 2018 global dust storm and Opportunity

explain.en: The cold comes earlier and stronger. Even the ice melter needs more power.
explain.pt: O frio chega mais cedo e mais forte. Até o derretedor precisa de mais energia.

source.label: NASA Solar System Exploration: Mars in depth

explain.en: No sunlight reaches the panels and it is too cold to go outside.
explain.pt: Nenhuma luz chega aos painéis e está frio demais para sair.

source.label: NASA Solar System Exploration: Mars in depth

explain.en: Bigger, longer dust devils damage panels and clog machines.
explain.pt: Redemoinhos maiores e mais longos danificam painéis e entopem máquinas.

source.label: Dust devils on Mars (they also cleaned Spirit's panels)

explain.en: Dust covers the whole planet, almost blacking out the Sun, like the 2018 storm that ended the Opportunity rover.
explain.pt: A poeira cobre o planeta inteiro e quase apaga o Sol, como a tempestade de 2018 que encerrou o rover Opportunity.

source.label: NASA JPL Edu: the 2018 global dust storm and Opportunity

explain.en: The final test: the worst storm of all.
explain.pt: O teste final: a pior tempestade de todas.

source.label: NASA JPL Edu: the 2018 global dust storm and Opportunity

explain.en: Autumn is now as cold as a winter.
explain.pt: O outono agora é frio como um inverno.

source.label: NASA Solar System Exploration: Mars in depth

explain.en: Only insulated habitats survive this winter.
explain.pt: Só módulos com isolamento sobrevivem a este inverno.

source.label: NASA Solar System Exploration: Mars in depth
